svg.aria-label: ACE V2 architecture: voice, USSD and SMS, which need no data, WhatsApp, RCS and apps, with RCS falling back to SMS, and other AI through MCP and API enter one pipeline with a speech layer and one pseudonymous identity per phone. The engine runs the safety rail, Scam Shield 2, decision services and a cited answer, reading a knowledge layer of signed packs, a number watcher, WHO and FAO guidelines and dated data snapshots filled by public data connectors, with opt in alerts, handoff and any model as outbound and optional parts.
